rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=noise, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=20, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-18 INIT-KIND fbp->noise (untried, all prior iters used fbp warm-start) from best. SIX-BOX:(1)PRIOR every iter used init=fbp; the pure-generative init=noise path is untested on breast. (2)Failure: below-FBP; tests whether losing the FBP warm-start (relying only on prior+DC from noise) collapses further -> isolates the FBP-anchor contribution. (3)ONE KNOB init fbp->noise.(4)HYPOTHESIS without the FBP anchor the mis-scaled Mayo prior dominates the init and PSNR drops well below 28.9, quantifying how much of the recon quality comes from the FBP warm-start vs the prior (expect a large drop). (5)BUDGET~150s.(6)loop.
